samples.summary: Virtualized launcher: suspicious packing; hostile intent unproven
Elex/Strictor: retain resource-dropper detection; fix trait placement
StormAttack: retain hijack/injection detection; relocate WinINet

reverse_engineering: Virtualized launcher: PE32+, four decoy imports, unbacked original sections and 24-MiB high-entropy executable region. Entry call chain saves registers and enters a keyed virtual-instruction dispatcher. CPU emulation reaches GS:[0x60] PEB access; a minimal mock PEB cannot recover the original application. Self-issued Game Launcher signer and resource claims do not establish a backdoor or masquerade. Family and final payload unresolved.

Elex/Strictor: emulated .vr decompressor until restored OEP 0x4045cc. Restored function 0x4020c2 copies IMAGE resource 132, subtracts a three-position additive key derived from its first two bytes, writes a DLL and invokes rundll32 with RAFlush. Decoded DLL exports RAFlush and carries a C2-looking endpoint plus NPKI/banking strings; these are corroboration, not trait gates. Separate REGINST resource decodes by an alternating additive key. Embedded Task Manager is a legitimate decoy, not keylogger proof.

StormAttack: function 0x401cb0 extracts the DLL and function 0x401390 uses VirtualAllocEx/WriteProcessMemory/CreateRemoteThread with LoadLibraryA. Function 0x401cb0 queries LanmanServer ServiceDLL, and the embedded payload references its overwrite target. Function 0x401900 writes Active Setup StubPath; 0x401fd0 copies the installer, creates an automatic Windows service and starts it. Embedded resource contains Storm DDoS command/configuration vocabulary. No Remcos or WannaCry identity claim is supported.

placement_review.empty_text: Artifact section property belongs in metadata/binary/section/layout; it is not evidence of an attacker objective. Removed behavioral suppressors from the neutral fact and updated all exact consumers.
placement_review.virtual_alloc: Allocation API names moved to mem/alloc/virtual, VirtualFree to mem/free. The required allocation/free/protection name conjunction moved to mem/combined. Exact references and the allocation-protection parent selector retain these members.
placement_review.loader_error: LOADER ERROR in .vr is UI error text, not an RL encoding operation. Moved to ui/dialog/error; all exact consumers updated.
placement_review.mfc: Structured CCmdTarget interface-map import is dependency metadata, not DLL loading or MFC product identity. Moved to metadata/binary/symbols/imports and set notable.
placement_review.wininet: WinINet DLL name is network-library vocabulary, not proof that this artifact is a library. Moved to communications/http/client/wininet. Audited family and library ancestor selectors; restored the former member explicitly in compatible Windows PE suppressors. Other ancestor selectors exclude PE or Windows. Removed behavioral suppression from the metadata import-absence property.
placement_review.labels: Renamed .vr and mmym section observations to describe their names, size and permissions; neither matcher proves entry-point membership or unpacking.
placement_review.unsupported_hostility: Packing and self-issued signing have legitimate uses. The self-issued packed-loader profile is suspicious; removed the masquerade composite that required no deceptive identity evidence.
